d:
The Pacers defeated the Wizards, 114-101 tonight in Indiana. Pascal Siakam finished with a team-high 28 points along with 8 rebounds and 5 assists for the Pacers, while Ivica Zubac tallied 20 points, 2 blocks and 12 rebounds in the game. Kyshawn George recorded 25 points, 9 rebounds and 5 three pointers. The Pacers improve their record to 4-8 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-8 for the season.
